items.en: Russia unveils Izdeliye 347, a truck-mounted ground launcher for a modified LMUR (Izdeliye 305) helicopter missile, at Tsentr-2026
items.nl: Rusland onthult Izdeliye 347, een lanceerinrichting op een vrachtwagen voor een aangepaste LMUR-helikopterraket (Izdeliye 305), tijdens Tsentr-2026
items.sEn: At the strategic exercise Tsentr-2026, Russia presented a new ground-based missile system, Izdeliye 347 ("Product 347"). items.en: Russian Mi-8 lost over Voronezh region, three crew killed; reportedly shot down by friendly fire during Ukrainian drone raid
items.nl: Russische Mi-8 verloren boven oblast Voronezj, drie bemanningsleden omgekomen; naar verluidt neergeschoten door eigen vuur tijdens Oekraïense droneaanval
items.sEn: A Russian military Mi-8 helicopter crashed on 1 October in a field in Anninsky district, about 80 km from Voronezh and roughly 200 km from the Ukrainian border. All three crew were killed: the pilot, the navigator and the gunner. The pro-Kremlin Telegram channel Mash reported the crash and the deaths that evening but…
items.sNl: Een Russische militaire Mi-8-helikopter stortte op 1 oktober neer in een veld in het district Anninski, ongeveer 80 km van Voronezj en zo'n 200 km van de Oekraïense grens. items.en: Ukraine strikes Novorossiysk naval base; Navy claims Neptune hit on Kalibr frigate Admiral Essen
items.nl: Oekraïne treft marinebasis Novorossiejsk; marine claimt Neptune-treffer op Kalibr-fregat Admiral Essen
items.sEn: On the night of 8–9 September 2026, Ukraine carried out a large combined deep-strike against Russia's naval base and commercial port at Novorossiysk (Krasnodar Krai) and against targets near Anapa and Gelendzhik. items.en: Russia unveils 'Dan-T' loitering munition as export counterpart to the 'Banderol' (S8000) missile-drone
items.nl: Rusland onthult zwerfmunitie 'Dan-T' als exportvariant van de 'Banderol' (S8000)-raketdrone
items.sEn: At the El Alamein International Airshow in Egypt (8-10 September 2026), Russia's state corporation Rostec publicly displayed for the first time a full-scale mockup of the "Dan-T" (Дань-Т) loitering munition.
